items.title: Being Gorenstein is a property of the formal fibres
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement verifies the five permanence properties of the formal fibres section for the property of being a Gorenstein ring (author lemma at source lines 4407-4412, label lemma-formal-fibres-gorenstein). The proof (source lines 4414-4449) handles (A) by dominating the field extension by a global complete intersection and using permanence under the resulting local complete intersection extension, (B) by locality, (C) and (D) by reducing to a regular local homomorphism whose fibre is regular and applying the flat preservation statement, and (E) because the condition does not mention the ground field (proof lines 4420-4448). Parts (A) and (C) are the substance. H3.
